prompts.straights: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: cardinal conveyor belt sprite source atlas for top-down factory game. Use attached industrial belt ONLY as material reference, change camera to strict orthographic TOP DOWN with absolutely no perspective. Generate a transparent-background 2x2 sheet with FOUR isolated straight belt segments, identical square cells and generous gutters. Top left horizontal belt traveling EAST/right with gold > chevrons. Top right horizontal belt traveling WEST/left with gold < chevrons. Bottom left vertical belt traveling SOUTH/down with gold downward V chevrons. Bottom right vertical belt traveling NORTH/up with gold upward chevrons. Clear one-direction markings on each entire belt. Casing is 0.50 width relative to 1.0 segment length; inner charcoal-black rubber carrying surface 0.32 width, restrained worn-steel side rails and tiny ivory ceramic side inset panels, minimal copper. Six simple repeated transverse rubber slats per straight, modest yellow ochre directional chevrons centered on surface. Constant cross-section from one open edge to the other; uncapped flat cut ends, no rollers at ends, no terminal collars, no end walls, no ground shadow, no support feet, no cargo or crates, no glow. Every segment has identical cross-section and proportions, but lighting stays fixed upper-left in all four pieces. Material should match reference and existing ivory/charcoal/copper factory hardware. Do not rotate lighting or show 3D sides. No text, labels, grid, arrows outside the belt, numbers or decorative background. This is source artwork to be registered into deterministic casings later, not an illustration scene.
prompts.corners: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: eight directed conveyor corner sprites on transparent source sheet. Strict orthographic TOP DOWN factory game hardware; match attached reference only in graphite rubber, steel edge and restrained ivory/copper materials, NOT its isometric camera. Sheet exactly FOUR columns by TWO rows with eight separate equal-size square cells and broad transparent gutters. Each belt makes a compact rounded 90-degree corner with constant width, open flat ends at two cardinal cell-edge midpoints, no terminal rollers, no end walls, no black end mouths, no collars. Exactly two terminals per corner. Top row ports and movement left-to-right across columns: W to S, W to N, N to E, E to S. Bottom row same FOUR physical corner silhouettes in same columns, but REVERSE the gold surface chevrons: S to W, N to W, E to N, S to E. Direction must be visible from gold chevrons following the bend, not floating external arrows. Belt outer width .5 relative to square cell width 1, carrying surface .32; dark flexible/slatted bed, muted metal side rails, small ivory side inserts. Keep lighting fixed from screen upper-left for every sprite; do not rotate baked lighting. No perspective, no cast ground shadows, no cargo, no labels/text/grid/numbers. Separate objects never touch each other. Avoid thick square hubs at bends. They are conveyor corners, not optical pipes: black load-bearing rubber with gold direction marks. IMPORTANT runtime constraint: packets follow a sharp L-shaped centerline THROUGH the corner vertex, not a shortened circular path. Each corner must include a flat square rubber turning pad centered at that vertex, continuous with both straight arms, large enough for a square item to pass through the vertex. Round only the outer casing silhouette; do not make the central load-bearing bed a hollow or crescent-shaped quarter circle. The pad has exactly two arms, no extra branches, no mechanical hub.
